headline: SNL Weekend Update: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on AI's Threat to Humanity
summary: Dario Amodei, CEO of AI safety company Anthropic, appeared on SNL's Weekend Update to discuss the existential risks posed by artificial intelligence.
details: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei made a guest appearance on Saturday Night Live's "Weekend Update" segment.
During his appearance, Amodei discussed the potential dangers and existential threats that advanced artificial intelligence could pose to humanity.
The segment aimed to bring a serious topic, AI safety, to a mainstream audience through humor and satire.
caption:

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei made a guest appearance on Saturday Night Live's "Weekend Update" segment.
